opportunities.name: Joint Base San Antonio (ANPI)
opportunities.timeline: Deployment targeted 2028 or earlier; ANPI goal ≥1 reactor operating by 2030
opportunities.instrument: ANPI selection (DAF + Defense Innovation Unit), contractor-owned/contractor-operated

opportunities.name: Buckley Space Force Base (ANPI)
opportunities.timeline: ANPI goal ≥1 reactor operating by 2030; Radiant FOAK to a USAF base in 2028

opportunities.name: Army Janus Program — nine candidate installations
opportunities.status: Five of nine sites matched to vendors, up to $2.2bn across FY2027-FY2031; agreements are fixed-price milestone-based Other Transaction Authority awards and none has been recorded as executed
opportunities.timeline: Sites announced November 2025; five vendors named 2026-08-26; Army-regulated reactor operational at a domestic installation by 2028-09-30
opportunities.vendor: Antares (Fort Bragg), Radiant (Benning), BWXT (Campbell), General Atomics (Hood), Westinghouse (Drum); four of the nine sites are still unassigned

opportunities.name: DOE DOME test bed, Idaho National Laboratory
opportunities.timeline: First fuelled experiment from spring 2026; Radiant fuel received 2026-07-01; Radiant campaign targeted to complete Q3 2026
opportunities.vendor: Radiant (first), Westinghouse eVinci, Ultra Safe Nuclear (FEEED)
opportunities.power_mw: Houses fuelled experiments up to 20 MWt
opportunities.instrument: DOE National Reactor Innovation Center test-bed access

opportunities.name: DOE Reactor Pilot Program — 11 projects
opportunities.status: Five critical, others in safety review
opportunities.timeline: Selected 2025-08-12; four reactors critical by the 2026-07-04 executive-order deadline (Antares Mark-0 2026-06-04, Valar Ward 250 2026-06-18, Deployable Unity 2026-07-01, Aalo-X 2026-07-04 at 12:20am, hours before the deadline expired), then Oklo's Groves Isotope Test Reactor afterward on 2026-08-05 — five critical as of this research
opportunities.vendor: 11 projects from 10 companies incl. Antares (Mark-0), Valar Atomics, Deployable Energy, Aalo, Oklo, Last Energy
opportunities.power_mw: Test-reactor scale; Deployable Energy's Unity is 1 MWe
opportunities.instrument: EO 14301 pilot program under DOE's own authorization authority, with no NRC license

opportunities.name: Eielson Air Force Base micro-reactor pilot
opportunities.timeline: NOITA announced 2025-06-11; 30-year firm-fixed-price contract to follow NRC licensing; DAF and NRC preparing environmental analysis
opportunities.power_mw: Power and heat; Aurora class above microreactor band
opportunities.instrument: Notice of Intent to Award. Oklo would design, construct, own and operate, selling electricity and heat under a long-term PPA

opportunities.name: Switch — 12 GW Oklo master power agreement
opportunities.timeline: Framework signed 2024-12; individual binding PPAs to follow per project
opportunities.instrument: Non-binding Master Power Agreement, the largest announced corporate nuclear framework; it grew Oklo's order book to ~14 GW

opportunities.name: Industrial Advanced Nuclear Consortium (IANC)
opportunities.timeline: ExxonMobil stated goal: make nuclear a viable option for industrial projects by 2030
opportunities.vendor: Technology-neutral; explicitly covers SMRs and MMRs
opportunities.power_mw: Use cases span remote well pads, offshore platforms, refinery/LNG heat, mining
opportunities.instrument: Demand-aggregation consortium, launched 2025-09-02 by The Open Group

opportunities.name: NANO Nuclear × Supermicro
opportunities.instrument: Strategic MOU for a standardized microreactor power package for data centers, pre-integrated with compute

opportunities.name: Texas Backup Power Package Program
opportunities.status: Live program, nuclear not yet eligible
opportunities.vendor: None; currently solar, battery and gas
opportunities.power_mw: Site-scale backup at hospitals, water treatment, nursing homes, police/fire

opportunities.name: DP World Thames Freeport — Last Energy PWR-20
opportunities.timeline: Preliminary Design Review completed with UK ONR July 2025; target online 2030
opportunities.instrument: Named commercial customer; UK regulatory review underway

opportunities.name: Saskatchewan Research Council eVinci pilot
opportunities.timeline: Cancelled fall 2025, when Westinghouse shifted eVinci to space, defense and government applications and away from commercial markets
opportunities.instrument: Was the first eVinci customer (CA$80M government funding, SRC as licensed operator); Westinghouse cancelled the contract in fall 2025

opportunities.name: Doicești NuScale VOYGR-6
opportunities.instrument: FID, the most construction-advanced U.S.-linked SMR export relationship

opportunities.name: U.S.–Japan–Korea trilateral SMR Memorandum of Cooperation
opportunities.timeline: Signed 2026-07-07 at the NATO Summit, Ankara
opportunities.instrument: Trilateral MOC: U.S. reactor design, Japan heavy manufacturing, Korea construction and supply chain

milestones.label: Selected for Joint Base San Antonio under ANPI
Mark-0 test reactor critical at INL (DOE Reactor Pilot Program)
R1 delivery to JBSA
ANPI goal: at least one reactor operating on a base
Mark-0 reached criticality at Idaho National Laboratory — the first privately built non-light-water reactor to go critical in the US in over 40 years
Dr. Rian Bahran joined as Chief Nuclear Officer from the Department of Energy, where he was Deputy Assistant Secretary for Nuclear Reactors
Closed a $470M Series C — $370M equity and $100M debt — to build the Mark-1 platform and field units from 2028
Selected for the Army's Janus programme at Fort Bragg, NC, to own, build and operate three R1 units. Antares declined to disclose the contract value.

Signed a definitive multi-year HALEU supply contract with Centrus; delivery before 2030 depends on Centrus completing its DOE-supported capacity expansion; prepayments disclosed, volume and price undisclosed
Equinix preorder with deposits: 20 Kaleidos units
Selected for Buckley Space Force Base under ANPI
First TRISO fuel received at INL's DOME test bed
DOME campaign complete: criticality through 150 h unattended run
FOAK Kaleidos to a USAF base
Won the largest Janus award — up to $750M to deploy 15 Kaleidos units by 2030, starting with three at Fort Benning, GA

Signed a definitive multi-year HALEU supply contract with Centrus; delivery before 2030 depends on Centrus completing its DOE-supported capacity expansion; prepayments disclosed, volume and price undisclosed
Penn State files NRC notice of intent for a 15 MWt eVinci-based research reactor CP
SRC first-customer contract cancelled; eVinci refocused on space, defence and government
Scaled 3 MWt heat-pipe test reactor selected for DOME testing
Selected for Malmstrom Air Force Base under ANPI
Malmstrom AFB operating (ANPI goal)
Selected for Janus at Fort Drum, NY, through Westinghouse Government Services
eVinci test assembly reached zero-power criticality at NCERC
Heated-core test reached criticality at 663°C and a 1,011°C peak at NCERC
Selected for Janus at Fort Campbell
Operation targeted in the early 2030s
Selected for Janus at Fort Hood
Ward 250 reached zero-power criticality in Utah
Aalo-X reached zero-power fueled criticality at INL
DOE preliminary safety approval announced for Aurora-INL
Groves Isotope Test Reactor reached zero-power fueled criticality at Lockhart, TX — the fifth DOE-authorized advanced reactor to do so

news_janus.headline: Westinghouse to bring eVinci to Fort Drum after Schumer push
news_janus.binding_note: A signed Janus OTA agreement, not a mere selection, though none of output, schedule or value has been disclosed for this specific pairing.

news_janus.headline: Radiant wins largest Janus award, up to $750M for 15 units
news_janus.binding_note: Radiant itself described this as a binding Janus agreement, the only one of the five vendors to publish its own award ceiling.

news_janus.headline: General Atomics to advance GA-TES microreactor at Fort Hood
news_janus.binding_note: A signed Janus OTA agreement covering development and testing milestones, not yet a deployment commitment; the company is explicitly in a development phase.

news_janus.headline: BWXT to deploy 20 MWe BANR reactor at Fort Campbell
news_janus.binding_note: A signed Janus OTA agreement; the specific dollar value was not disclosed.

news_janus.headline: Army awards up to $2.2bn across five bases for microreactors
news_janus.binding_note: Each vendor holds a signed, executed OTA agreement, not a preliminary selection — funds release against technical milestones for prototype construction and a first year of operation, after which the Army plans to shift to a power purchase agreement. Per-vendor dollar figures beyond Radiant's remain undisclosed.

news_janus.headline: Antares to build three R1 microreactors at Fort Bragg
news_janus.binding_note: A signed Janus OTA agreement, not a mere selection; the dollar value of this specific award is undisclosed, only the combined cross-program total.
